en.dataCountsCached: served from folds already taken, without re-reading
en.dataExcludedValue: A forked session’s inherited prefix (already billed to its parent), calls still in flight, and sessions that could not be read.
en.dataFlow: The process running the dsh server reads the logs and folds them in its own memory; the samples it folds (never any message body) are cached at <DSH_HOME>/local-usage/fold-cache.json so a restart need not re-read the logs. Apart from those local reads and writes it makes no external request and uploads nothing.
en.dataHowValue: The complete log is read through the session query service and replay-validated; each completed billed settlement becomes one sample, filed under the local day of its own instant.
en.dataIntro: The figures are folded from the durable session event logs. The harness writes each model call’s token accounting into the log event for that call, and there is no separate usage database, so the statistics have to read the logs themselves.
en.dataScopeValue: Every session on this host, across all working directories — not just the current workspace.
en.dataWhereValue: DSH_HOME defaults to ~/.dsh; older sessions are named session.jsonl.zstd.
en.dataWindowValue: The last {weeks} weeks ({days} days), ending today.
en.dayEmpty: No usage recorded on this day.
en.daySubtitle: This day’s usage, split by the directory it was spent in
en.error: Usage data could not be read.
en.heading: Usage statistics
en.noUsage: No usage recorded in this range.
en.pricingEditorEmpty: This window recorded no routes yet, so there is nothing to price by hand. Pick a wider range, or come back once the window has a call in it.
en.pricingFormula: Cost = Σ (each token bucket × its rate) ÷ 1,000,000, with peak or off-peak decided per call at the moment it happened.
en.pricingInvalid: A rate must be a number of at least 0
en.pricingNotBill: The figure is therefore an estimate. Prepaid credit, package plans, volume discounts, granted balance, aggregator markups and reseller margins are all invisible here, so it will differ from what you are actually charged; treat the provider invoice as authoritative.
en.pricingPageSubtitle: One card per model, shared by every vendor route of it; the usage below is grouped the same way.
en.pricingPeakSchedule: Peak: {windows} (Beijing time, {weekdayScope}); every other hour is billed at the off-peak prices, and the two sets are set independently.
en.pricingSource: The rates come from this plugin’s own price table, not from a provider invoice: the harness records tokens, never currency.
en.pricingTooltip: Rates and how cost is computed
en.pricingUnknownRoute: unknown means the log recorded no provider/model for the call; multiple means one turn switched models.
en.rankingEmpty: No project usage in this range.
